name: Paid online surveys (Leger LEO panel)
summary: Answer market-research surveys for points you can redeem for cash, travel miles or gift cards; legitimate, but the earnings look too small to recommend as a way to earn.
whatYouDo: You join Leger's LEO panel and get survey invitations. Each survey shows its estimated time and points reward before you start, and points build up until you reach a redemption threshold.
appeal: Canadian-owned research firm with a large North American panel (400,000+ members, per Leger)
Rewards include cash, PayPal, Air Miles, Aeroplan or gift cards
Surveys show their time and reward up front
watchOuts: Rejected for this tool: no source supports a meaningful effective hourly rate
Third-party reviews put surveys at roughly $0.50–$35 each, with 1,000 points worth $1
Cash-type rewards reportedly need 20,000 points (about $20) before you can redeem (not checked against Leger's terms)
Reviews are mixed: many negative user reviews alongside positive app ratings
Survey income, not a job: no guarantee of hours or volume

compensation.notes: Third-party reviews say about $0.50–$35 per survey, with 1,000 points ≈ $1. No source gave an hourly figure.

reliability.notes: Invitations depend on panel demand and your profile. No volume data was found.

applicationSteps: Join the LEO panel through Leger's app
Complete the survey invitations you qualify for
Redeem your points once you reach the threshold
fitsIf: You already enjoy doing surveys for points or travel miles and don't mind small rewards.
notFitIf: You want meaningful income for your time.

sources.title: Leger launches LEO: the mobile app to give your opinion
sources.notes: From a search summary of this press release: members earn points per completed survey, redeemable for cash, Air Miles, Aeroplan or gift cards. Leger calls itself the largest Canadian-owned research firm, with 400k+ panel members in North America. Direct fetch was blocked.

sources.title: leo review
sources.notes: Third-party review: about $0.50–$35 per survey, 1,000 points = $1. Redemption needs 10,000 points for Air Miles or Aeroplan and 20,000 for gift cards or PayPal. It notes many bad reviews.

sources.title: LEO (Leger Opinion) review
sources.notes: Third-party review: the LEO app is rated about 4.2/5 from 1,100+ Google Play reviews, and the panel dates from 2004.
